name: [[312,104,4]] two-block code over C78 x C2

provenance.construction: Two-block group-algebra code C(a,b) over C78 x C2 = SmallGroup(156, 18) (order 156), elements numbered as in GAP Elements(SmallGroup(order,id)) with element 0 the identity. n = 2|G| = 312; H_X = [L(a)|R(b)], H_Z = [R(b)^T|L(a)^T]; a = {0, 1, 35, 57, 61}, b = {0, 1, 46, 61} as element indices. Check weight 9. Parameters and blocks taken from the public code database of arXiv:2610.13880v1 (Lee, 'Bicycle Race'), github.com/gideonlsx/bicycle-race.
provenance.notes: Parameters and construction taken from the public database of arXiv:2610.13880v1. Distance is an upper bound certified by the witnesses attached here. Parameters and blocks taken from the public code database of arXiv:2610.13880v1 (Lee, 'Bicycle Race'), github.com/gideonlsx/bicycle-race @ aed705a, CC BY 4.0; rebuilt here with the repo's own group data. Distance is an upper bound certified by the attached witnesses, not the paper's exact distance.

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over integer-grid site assignments with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout, single layer at radius 4 then two layers at 7, plus a divisor scan of the two-block index convention Z_l x Z_m which gives the tighter embedding here; radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's own rule.
